# a deep offer quota chain
job=campaign(rows3,
             [offer('A',capacity=3,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3')),
              offer('B',capacity=3,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2','r3'))],
             rq=9,og=9)
job['offer_quotas']=[{'id':'n0','parent':None,'capacity':9}]
for i in range(1,20):
    job['offer_quotas'].append({'id':'n%d'%i,'parent':'n%d'%(i-1),'capacity':9})
job['offer_quotas'].append({'id':'leaf','parent':'n19','capacity':3})
for o in job['offers']: o['group']='leaf'
out=run(job)
check_plan(job,out['plan'],active(out))
check('deep offer chain',out['plan']['resolved'],3)
